verdict.rationale: Kong's own docs and repo state that deployments can be driven by declarative configuration "without any vendor lock-in". Kong also exports AI traffic metrics in the open OTLP format and lets you pull Konnect audit logs on demand, so some data can leave in open forms. However, no evidence shows a documented way to export all of a user's data (config, Konnect catalog, Dev Portal content, analytics) for migration. missing for 10: documented full-data export or dump command (e.g. decK export of complete config), coverage of Konnect SaaS data (catalog, portal, analytics), stated export formats and offboarding guidance, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Sophisticated deployment models like Declarative Databaseless Deployment and Hybrid Deployment (control plane/data plane separation) without any vendor lock-in.
AI Gateway can export OpenTelemetry (OTLP) metrics for generative AI, MCP, and A2A traffic through an OpenTelemetry AI Policy.
For Konnect org audit logs, you can also use an audit log pull to retrieve logs on demand from the API.
